result.title: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration: Methods, Trade-Offs, and Open Questions
result.summary: Diffusion and flow-based generative models support high-quality image, audio, and video synthesis. Sampling can require dozens to hundreds of denoiser evaluations, with each pass becoming more expensive as resolution, video length, or model size increases. This cost affects latency and energy use in interactive and edge applications. We examine four approaches to accelerating inference: distillation, consistency training, sampling methods, and denoiser design. We express training objectives, transition maps, and numerical updates in a common notation to compare changes to the learning target, the sampling trajectory, and the work performed within each denoiser pass. Published image and video benchmarks illustrate the quality--cost trade-offs of one- and few-step generation, the interaction between solvers and timestep schedules, the effect of feature caching, and the difference between first-frame latency and sustained streaming throughput. We close with open problems in visual-native architectures and post-compression distillation, solver-aware few-step training, and semantic trajectory alignment with factorized distribution matching.

AI.brief_summary: 一篇综述，用统一记号梳理扩散与 flow 模型推理加速的四类途径（蒸馏、一致性训练、采样器、去噪器设计），并对比少步生成的质量—成本权衡、求解器与时间步调度、特征缓存以及首帧延迟与流式吞吐的差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把多步采样轨迹蒸馏为少步」与「特征缓存复用」的讨论，可能为 LVR 中压缩 latent 推理步数、缓存对状态相似度影响提供可供核查的类比线索，但本身不涉及多模态推理。
